name: Black Seraph Style (Combat, Style)
body:
You laugh off the cowardly assaults of your foes.

Prerequisites: Intimidate 3 ranks, one Black Seraph stance known.

Benefit: Against the abilities of creatures that are shaken, frightened, panicked, or cowering, you gain a +1 profane bonus to your AC and on saving throws. This bonus increases by +1 at character level 5th and at every five levels thereafter.
